liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (2 reviews): Reviewer rates this among the best 1987 versions of the song; Reviewer urges getting this show's Jack Straw [19][25]
- **Devil With A Blue Dress** (2 reviews): Reviewer played this Devil into Good Golly Miss Molly at parties, and even non-fans loved it; Reviewer calls this the best Devil into Blue Dress ever played [18][23]
- **The Wheel** (2 other sources): A Watchtower tease comes out of The Wheel; The space within The Wheel is included in this release [3][5]
- **Hey Pocky Way** (1 review): Reviewer describes an energetic, breezy opener that wakes them up [27]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Brent's pretty piano playing lifts an otherwise mundane version [27]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 other source): It leads into Devil With The Blue Dress, then Good Golly Miss Molly, then back to Devil [1]
- **Gimme Some Lovin'** (1 other source): A Watchtower tease comes just before Gimme Some Lovin' [4]

## The recordings

- **gd87-09-09.sbd.miller.21014.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 134 min; rated 3.88/5 by 17 [1]. Said about its sound: This soundboard copy sounds much better than the audience tape the reviewer had worn out; Reviewer finds this muffled and not crisp, and recommends another version from the Audio 30 server; Slightly muffled, but still a good soundboard worth having [18][20][22]
- **gd1987-09-09.sbd.miller.106823.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 135 min; rated 3.5/5 by 8 [3]
- **gd1987-09-09.151427.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 24 songs; 134 min; rated 1/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1987-09-09.176265.senn441.lamarre.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 131 min [5]
- **gd87-09-09.naks.valis-under.6686.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 23 songs; 128 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [11]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this an excellent audience source [26]
- **gd87-09-09.sony.dnc.8598.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 22 songs; 134 min; rated 4.4/5 by 15 [13]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds this muffled and not crisp, and recommends another version from the Audio 30 server; Reviewer calls it a nice audience recording; The audience recording is a bit less than superb, but still worth getting [21][23][24]

## Around the show

- Reviewer skipped the Providence shows to attend the Cap Centre show instead [18]
- After Brent died, a friend gave the reviewer this show as his best Brent tape [19]
- The band always seemed to enjoy playing in Providence [23]
- Reviewer says Brent seemed ready to explode at times, and it was a spectacular night for him [24]
- Reviewer hears the band's return after Jerry recovered, with energy signaling they weren't going anywhere [26]
- The band played three nights in Providence, which the reviewer finds rare for a band of this stature [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd87-09-09.sbd.miller.21014.sbeok.shnf**: source: Recording Info:SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat [1]. Also: Soundboard to cassette master, then DAT on a Tascam DA-20mkII, Behringer SRC2000, CD, EAC, Samplitude, and SHN [1]
- **gd1987-09-09.sbd.miller.106823.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) [3]. Also: This transfer was pitch corrected, with help from Joe B. Jones [3]
- **gd1987-09-09.151427.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [4]. Also: Andrew F.'s Nakamichi 300 source supplies the first 0:52 of Hey Pocky Way and a 0:32 Drums/Space patch [4]
- **gd1987-09-09.176265.senn441.lamarre.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Doug Lamarre; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Doug Lamarre's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > Sony D5M [5]. Also: A 0:09 patch in Space comes from the Sennheiser ME-80 source [5]
- **gd87-09-09.naks.valis-under.6686.sbeok.shnf**: source: Nak 300's > Sony D5 Casette Master > Sound Forge (wav) > Shorten [11]
- **gd87-09-09.sony.dnc.8598.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Nak DR1 using Azimuth adjustment > Sony PCMR500 DAT with SBM ON for A>D > Turtle Beach Montego II Digital I/O sound card >CDWav > Shorten; source: OTS > Sony ECM220T mics > Sony TCDM5 Cassette deck > Maxell MX90 tapes NO DOLBY [13]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1987-09-08 Providence Civic Center, Providence, RI, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-09-08-providence-civic-center-providence-ri-usa/) [31]
